title: Edward Reekers - Edward Reekers - The Words To Say I love You (Tradução) [WL]

lines.l: And as the sign clears, memories are faded to awaken
Passage to whichever road you're taking
Is it plain enough for words
Or just too complex to see the move we're making
Love will soothe the ones that feel forsaken
Emotions that are hardly worth to mention
Could in itself not even raise attention
Never let your shadow walk before you
Ripples getting burned to hide and sail through
Catch the moment when it's there
Don't expect more of the storm that you can cling to
We would need the words to say I love you
We would need the words to say I love you
